title: Search Project Contents
trigger: User needs to find text or files across the project

steps.action: Press Ctrl+K or click the search field on the right of the switcher bar
The search overlay covers the tool window; type a term or use filters like ext:ts, path:src/, kind:script
Results appear at the top with file locators on the left and preview on the right; matches are highlighted
Narrow results in the same field using filters, or press Enter or double-click to open the focused result in File Viewer
The result file opens in a File Viewer tab in the same cluster; press Escape to close the search overlay

outcome: Search results appear with file locations and preview, and a result can be opened in the editor
